subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should this PR publish the docs-first launchd runbook that tells gateway-only macOS operators to patch the env wrapper, boot out and disable the legacy node LaunchAgent, and reload with launchctl while leaving runtime hardening in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89791?
rationale: The source and reporter evidence support the workaround, but public docs that instruct users to disable a service are an operator-availability policy choice that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Accept Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Land this PR as immediate recovery guidance for affected gateway-only hosts, with the linked runtime issue kept open for generated-wrapper and doctor/install hardening.

options.title: Pause For Runtime Policy
options.body: Hold the docs until maintainers decide and implement durable launchd marker, node-service, and doctor/install behavior.

options.title: Narrow The Published Steps
options.body: Keep the detection and wrapper-order documentation but remove or soften the node LaunchAgent disable flow until owner approval is explicit.

recommendation.title: Accept Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Land this PR as immediate recovery guidance for affected gateway-only hosts, with the linked runtime issue kept open for generated-wrapper and doctor/install hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the launchd, service-env, and node daemon surfaces involved in the operator-policy decision.
